collection: Normal anonymous official browser UI; Loews room link followed to Universal reservation engine, explicit dates and counts updated, public rate details inspected. No Book Now, cart, hold, account, purchase or contact action.

persisted_party.basis: Count-only family search. Requested ages fall within displayed band but engine did not request or confirm individual ages. Not an exact-age booking acceptance.

currency.basis: US Orlando official storefront and dollar display; USD is an editorial interpretation, not an observed ISO label. No conversion.

room_facts_observed.sleeping_places: Two queen beds and a sleeper sofa
room_facts_observed.separation: Privacy partition between bedroom and living space
room_facts_observed.basis: Official room page and exact named booking category agree; no allocation of children to beds or firsthand rest/suitability verdict.

plans.name: Special Offer
plans.inclusions: Five room nights and displayed Taxes line. This is the rate-detail subtotal, not a final all-fee checkout quote.
plans.offer_restrictions_observed: Not combinable with other offers/discounts. Valid theme park admission required for described early admission; select attractions.
plans.eligibility_limit: Shown in anonymous six-person results without login; no residency/passholder/member verification observed. Unshown eligibility and final terms remain unknown.

plans.name: Flexible Rate
plans.inclusions: Five room nights and displayed Taxes line. This is the rate-detail subtotal, not a final all-fee checkout quote.
plans.offer_restrictions_observed: General description calls it lowest published non-discounted double-occupancy rate before tax. The actual result/detail headers retained 1 room, 2 adults, 4 children; no assumption of individualized child pricing.
plans.eligibility_limit: Public anonymous result; name Flexible alone does not establish refundable cancellation or payment conditions.

unresolved_budget.parking: Separate unresolved current add-on. Existing model retains Sept24 $26 plus tax per vehicle/night; not rechecked or renewed by this collection and not added to quoted subtotal.
unresolved_budget.tickets: Theme park admission is not included or priced by these room-only samples.

park_notice_observed: Booking results say Volcano Bay seasonal closure begins October26,2026; expected reopening on or before April1,2027, not confirmed. Walking path unavailable during closure. This does not establish hotel-pool/lazy-river operations or ticket inclusion.

use.result: Existing Cabana nightly budget gap narrowed with two source-backed same-count/same-stay/exact-category plan observations. Not a seasonal price band, cheapest claim, complete family budget or age-confirmed booking.
use.next_gate: Map reviewed sample into existing structured comparison only after approved release-history reconciliation and separate reviewed implementation/QA; preserve original facts and observation window. Recheck offer eligibility, current parking and final terms before any complete-budget claim.
